chunks: About staying with the people of al-kharaj, and he said: “Three days.”

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْخَرَاجِ: the people connected to kharaj, land-tax payers or holders of taxed land
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: the specified duration of three days
key_terms.عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ: A transmitter who asked the Imam عليه السلام about the ruling

ai.seo_question: How long may one stay with Ahl al-Kharaj according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling concerning staying with Ahl al-Kharaj, the people associated with land tax. The Imam عليه السلام set the limit at three days, indicating a specific juristic boundary in this matter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3882 - Abdullah bin Sinan asked him about staying with the people who pay land tax (Ahl al-Kharaj).
